title: Bind coordination CLI and MCP bridge callers to a per-session capability
outcome: The Phase 1 loopback HTTP API is intentionally unauthenticated: the delegation MCP bridge asserts its identity through --parent-session-id and the coordination CLI through --as-session, and both apply the root-session guard as a misuse guard, not as an authenticated containment boundary. Any process with shell access to the machine can list root sessions (ids, names, previews, workdirs) and claim a root id. Follow-up: issue a per-session capability token at runtime spawn (delivered only to that session's MCP child / CLI environment), require it on the mailbox, board and inventory routes, and reject asserted identities without it. Raised by the Claude reviewer during the tm-d272 dual review; documented as a limitation in docs/features/coordination-cli.md until implemented.
